id: title:dmarchuk:retry each apns device rejected for its provider token

review.posthog_relevance: Push notification delivery reliability and recovery from Apple APNs token rejection, potentially reducing failed notifications and improving user engagement.
review.reason: The implementation P1.F2.H1 adds a conditional JWT refresh before retrying a rejected APNs request. This changes the behavior of the push notification delivery workflow: when Apple rejects the authentication token, the system now refreshes it and retries, rather than immediately failing. review.uncertainty: The actual reduction in failed notifications and the operational benefit depend on the frequency of token rejection and the robustness of the refresh mechanism, which are not demonstrated by the code alone. observations.behavior: The implementation P1.F2.H1 adds a conditional JWT refresh before retrying a rejected APNs request, while P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H3 change the test expectations and assertions. P1.F1.H2 adds a new test for retrying a rejected device when another device succeeded.
observations.posthog_connection: Push notifications are sent to mobile devices; if Apple rejects the JWT, the service now refreshes the token before retrying, potentially improving delivery reliability. P1.F1.H2 and P1.F1.H3 update tests to expect the new behavior, including a log message and a higher number of fetch calls.
